offering_description.value: Owns and operates the Merom Generating Station, a coal-fired power plant in Indiana, and sells electricity and capacity to utilities and the wholesale power market. It previously mined coal but has exited mining, and is pursuing additional dispatchable generation including gas and data center load.

customer_segment.value: B2B: utilities, wholesale power markets (MISO), and commercial power buyers

end_markets.value: electric power generation; wholesale electricity markets; utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: electricity and capacity sold under power purchase agreements and into wholesale markets

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs a coal-fired power plant using purchased coal, selling power to utilities and the grid

geography_served.value: US regional: Indiana plant selling into the MISO Midwest power market

specialization.value: niche specialist: power generation from a single coal-fired plant, with development of gas generation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bilateral power contracts with utilities and sales into the MISO wholesale market

regulatory_exposure.value: high: power generation subject to EPA emissions rules, FERC and MISO market rules, and Indiana regulators

notes: Mining operations were sold per my knowledge; plans for new generation are uncertain.
